title: Grand Terrace with Earl Hines and going to Europe in 1929
summary: After returning from Europe in 1929 she worked a few weeks with Earl Hines at the Grand Terrace, did Show Boat in London with Paul Robeson, and kept going back and forth.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah, it was pretty fancy. But the Sunset was -- now listen, I tell you one thing, in 1929 -- in 1929 I know I went to work at the with Earl Hines. At the Grand Terrace. I'm sure.
I had been to Europe. I had been to Europe and I came back. And when I came back I went out there and then did a few weeks with Earl Hines.
And then what? Did you go back to Europe?
I kept going back and forth. Uh-huh.
So you did -- well, we haven't got to that, yet.
You did "Showboat" in London with Paul Robeson.
Then you came back and then you went to France and all over the place.
